mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near the Military Ridge State Trail, but the air quality is moderate at 73. We have a waxing gibbous moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible for three minutes starting at 5:45 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and passing toward the northeast near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 44 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city wants to remind you about the toilet rebate program for residential properties to help with water conservation. Also, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving into a new phase, with underground work finished and concrete work currently underway.

It is a big week for trivia lovers with events today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory tomorrow. Looking ahead, you can also catch live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee on Thursday.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Wednesday, October 15, they arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no one was injured during the incident.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by before they close for the night at 10:00 PM to enjoy a scoop.
